verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a live llms.txt at developers.fathom.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It indexes the API docs as markdown pages (Introduction, Quickstart, …) that an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404), and no first-party docs page describing the llms.txt or agent-oriented docs offering.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
